mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the subsequent 20 trading days as the monetary policy stance supports risk asset performance.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 7.5% signals labor market distress, prompting equity investors to anticipate reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 7.5, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicate weakening aggregate demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market participants price in reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction term's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 265) indicates a high inflation regime where the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the subsequent 60 trading days as bond yields rise and equity valuations contract.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 265, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A low level of industrial production (INDPRO < 100) reflects a contraction in the manufacturing and industrial sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate profits face headwinds from reduced output.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts (HOUST) decline below 1400 thousand units signals deteriorating residential market conditions, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as real estate weakness dampens consumer confidence and spending.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 1400, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high unemployment (UNRATE > 7.5%) and ultra-low interest rates (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%) indicate a recessionary environment with limited monetary policy space, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate earnings deterioration.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of periods when UNRATE > 7.5 AND FEDFUNDS <= 0.5, or the interaction term's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained industrial production contraction (INDPRO < 95) indicates a weakening manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as supply chain disruptions and reduced output pressure corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
